description: This file contains Python code for generating a Kconfig file for PetaLinux, including functions for recipe processing, directory management, and command registration within a build system.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Appends a string to the output Kconfig file.

methods.name: sanity_test
methods.description: Runs a sanity check on the generated Kconfig file using bitbake and related commands.

methods.name: rename_dir
methods.description: Renames a directory if it exists.

methods.name: kconfig_recipe_format
methods.description: Formats recipe information into Kconfig entries and writes to the file.

methods.name: get_exclude_pkgs
methods.description: Reads and parses exclude packages JSON file.

methods.name: plnxkconfig
methods.description: Main function to generate the Kconfig file based on recipes and their metadata.

methods.name: register_commands
methods.description: Registers the 'gen-plnx-kconfig' command for the build system.
